description:
Are you ready to own something big? Automox is turning IT admins into IT heroes by replacing traditional tools with our award winning cloud-native endpoint management platform. Our product works autonomously and so do our teams. We value a ‘one team’ mentality where everyone’s unique skills contribute to an environment that encourages collaboration and ownership. At Automox you’re enabled to do your best work, grow your career, and have an impact that will be noticeable. WE ARE A_TOMOX… all that’s missing is U! 

We are seeking a Product Manager to own the day-to-day execution of product initiatives. This role is focused on translating strategy into action: gathering customer insights, defining crisp requirements, coordinating cross-functional teams, and ensuring features are delivered with quality and impact.

You don’t need to be an endpoint management expert, what matters is your ability to partner with Engineering, Design, and Customer-facing teams to deliver meaningful outcomes for our customers.

 

Customer Discovery & Insights

  • Conduct customer interviews and analyze feedback to ensure we’re solving real problems.
  • Translate customer pain points into actionable requirements and user stories.
  • Maintain a strong feedback loop with CX, Sales, and Support to validate direction.

Execution & Delivery

  • Own the day-to-day management of features from definition through release.
  • Write clear, testable acceptance criteria in Jira and ensure requirements are well understood.
  • Partner with TPMs and EMs to ensure scope, dependencies, and timelines are well managed.
  • Support release readiness: documentation, enablement, customer comms, and internal GTM handoffs.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Design to ensure solutions are intuitive and user-centric.
  • Collaborate with Engineering to break down features into deliverable increments and track progress.
  • Coordinate with Product Marketing to ensure messaging, enablement, and launch activities align.

Mindset & Behaviors

  • Obsess over clarity - remove ambiguity for teams by providing context and detail.
  • Be execution-oriented: track details, follow up relentlessly, and ensure commitments are met.
  • Communicate proactively on scope changes, tradeoffs, and delivery risks.
  • Balance urgency with thoughtfulness: deliver fast, but never at the expense of customer trust.

 

BACKGROUND & SKILLS REQUIRED

  • 2-4 years of product management experience, preferably in SaaS or B2B platforms.
  • Comfortable attending and leading Scrum ceremonies.
  • Experience in agile/Scrum environments.
  • Strong ability to turn ambiguous customer needs into actionable requirements.
  • Skilled at writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and product documentation.
  • Proven track record working with cross-functional teams (Engineering, Design, TPMs, CX, Marketing).
  • Strong communication skills — able to align technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience using Jira, Aha!, or similar product management tools.
  • Comfortable interviewing customers and synthesizing insights into product direction.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with IT operations, security, or endpoint management.
  • CPM or CPO
  • Experience with Figma

The salary range listed is the base pay range for this position. In addition, the total compensation package includes bonus, equity and benefits. Actual earnings may be less or more depending on a candidate's direct experience, skills, industry knowledge, and location.

Compensation
$125,000—$150,000 USD

LOCATION

We are a fully distributed company of remote employees.

***Note: We currently don't hire in California or New York metro***

ABOUT AUTOMOX

Automox is the cloud-native IT operations platform for modern organizations. Our award-winning answer to modern IT operations and best-in-class results earned Automox four straight quarters of record growth. We are now trusted by more than 2,500 leading companies and MSPs worldwide, including NASA, Yale, Xerox, Allbirds, and Unicef. It makes it easy to keep every endpoint automatically configured, patched, and secured – anywhere in the world. The future of IT Operations is cloud-native – and right now. Will you join us?

EMPLOYMENT AT AUTOMOX

✅ Must be able to pass a federal, state, county background check
✅ Complete a local in-person verification

TOTAL REWARDS: Thrive with Us
